newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: ALUMINIUM BAHRAIN TO PRODUCE 500,000 T IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: ALUMINIUM BAHRAIN TO PRODUCE 500,000 T IN 1997.

text.p: Aluminium Bahrain (Alba), the Middle East's biggest aluminium producer, is on target to produce 500,000 tonnes in 1997, an Alba newsletter said.
"Alba is on target to achieve the milestone of 500,000 tonnes of aluminium production by the end of 1997," said the Albayan newsletter which was received on Thursday.
It said Alba's finished product totalled 228,487 tonnes on June 16 this year, up by 22,000 tonnes from a year earlier and billet production stood at 72,196 tonnes, up by 27,117 tonnes.
The increase followed the completion of a $130 million expansion project at the smelter which added 36,500 tonnes a year to Alba's previous annual production capacity of 460,000 tonnes.
Alba is 77 percent owned by the Bahraini government and 20 percent held by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund. German group Breton Investments holds the remaining three percent.
